title: Raphinha Apologizes to Cubarsi After Barcelona-Dortmund Clash
text:
Barcelona’s dominant performance against Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League quarterfinals has set the stage for an exciting second leg. Learn how Barcelona secured a commanding lead with a convincing 4-0 victory, showcasing impressive goals throughout the match. This article breaks down the key moments, controversies, and reactions from both players and coaches following the thrilling Barcelona vs. Dortmund fixture.
Barcelona Dominates Dortmund in Champions League Quarterfinal April 9, 2025
FC Barcelona secured a commanding 4-0 victory over Borussia Dortmund in the first leg of thier Champions League quarterfinal, placing them in a strong position for the semifinals.
Match Highlights Opening Goal: Raphinha scored the opening goal for Barcelona. Second Half Surge: Robert Lewandowski scored twice in the second half. Yamal’s Goal: Lamine Yamal added another goal to Barcelona’s tally. Raphinha’s Controversial Goal Raphinha’s early goal was initially in doubt due to a possible offside. The play involved a shot from Pau Cubarsi that the Dortmund goalkeeper deflected. Raphinha then touched the ball, ultimately being credited with the goal.
I was worried about being offside, I had a doubt.so much the better if they validated it. I said to Cubarsi (who had struck Edlr) that I had touched the ball before the line, I apologized to him and he told me that there was no problem, that it would make him a decisive pass. It was a rapid action, I put the foot in case it was not,
Raphinha, movistar
The goal stood, marking Raphinha’s 12th LDC goal of the season.
Reactions After the Match despite the notable victory, both players and the coach emphasized the importance of the second leg.
There remains a match and it is always intricate to play in front of their supporters. We have obeyed a good result but it will be necessary to make a good match next week.
Raphinha
Coach Hansi Flick echoed this sentiment, stating:
We are not qualified, football is a crazy sport.
Hansi Flick
Looking Ahead The second leg of the quarterfinal is scheduled for next Tuesday in Germany. Barcelona will need to maintain their focus to secure their place in the Champions League semifinals.
Key points for the upcoming match:
Location: Signal Iduna Park, Dortmund Date: Next Tuesday Challenge: Playing in front of Dortmund’s home crowd
